blocks.text: Shakhdar zanjeer wale alkanes ke naam in usoolon se rakhe jate hain.

items: Carbon atoms ki sab se lambi musalsal zanjeer dhundein; yeh parent naam tay karti hai. Jis compound ki sab se lambi zanjeer mein chhe carbons hon woh hexane hai chahe zanjeer muri hui ho; sab se lambi zanjeer formula likhne ke andaz se zahir na bhi ho, aur agar sab se lambi zanjeer mein saat carbons hon to compound heptane hai.
Sab se lambi zanjeer ko substituent ke qareeb wale sire se number dein.
Usool 2 ke numbers se substituent ki jagah batayein: parent naam aakhir mein aur substituent, apne number ke saath, pehle (maslan 2-methylhexane).

Do ya zyada substituents hon to har ek ko sab se lambi zanjeer par us ki jagah ka number dein, maslan 4-ethyl-2-methylhexane. Substituents ko huroof-e-tahajji ki tarteeb mein likhein (ethyl methyl se pehle), di aur tri jaise zarb ke prefixes nazar-andaz karte hue.
Jab do substituents ek hi carbon par hon to woh number do baar istemal karein.
Jab do ya zyada substituents ek jaise hon to di, tri, tetra waghaira ke prefixes istemal karein, aur yaqeeni banayein ke har substituent ka number ho.
Jab barabar lambai ki do zanjeerein parent ke liye muqabla karein to zyada substituents wali chunein.
Jab shakh sab se lambi zanjeer ke dono siron se barabar faasle par pehle aaye to woh naam chunein jo pehle farq ke nuqte par chhota number de.

blocks.alt: Do condensed formulae; sab se lambi carbon zanjeer neeli shaded aur substituent CH3 gulabi daire mein. Pehla: seedhi chhe carbon zanjeer jis ke paanchwen carbon par CH3. Doosra: zanjeer CH par neeche mur kar CH2 aur CH3 tak jati hai, saat carbons, aur daire wala CH3 daen taraf.
blocks.caption: Usool 1 ki misalein: sab se lambi musalsal zanjeer (hexane aur heptane) (kitab ke safha 247 par chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Wahi do compounds numbers ke saath. Mura hua heptane oopar 7, 6, 5, 4, 3 aur mor ke neeche 2, 1; daire wala CH3 carbon 3 par, teer us par 'Substituent' likhta hai. Hexane baen se daen 6 se 1; daire wala CH3 carbon 2 se latka hai, teer 'Substituent'.
blocks.caption: Usool 2 ki misalein: substituent ke qareeb wale sire se numbering (kitab ke safha 247 par chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Number shuda shaded zanjeerein naamon ke saath: carbon 3 par daire wale CH3 wali muri saat carbon zanjeer 3-methylheptane; carbon 2 par CH3 wali seedhi chhe carbon zanjeer 2-methylhexane.
blocks.caption: Usool 3 ki misalein: 3-methylheptane aur 2-methylhexane (kitab ke safha 248 par chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Shaded zanjeer H3C-CH-CH2-CH-CH2-CH3, number 1 se 6. Carbon 2 se daire wala CH3 aur carbon 4 se daire wala CH2 jis se daire wala CH3 jura hai (ethyl group). Naam: 4-Ethyl-2-methylhexane.
blocks.caption: Usool 4 ki misal: 4-ethyl-2-methylhexane (kitab ke safha 248 par chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Zanjeer H3C-CH2-C-CH2-CH2-CH3, number 1 se 6. Carbon 3 par oopar CH3 aur neeche CH2-CH3 (ethyl). Naam: 3-Ethyl-3-methylhexane.
blocks.caption: Usool 5 ki misal: 3-ethyl-3-methylhexane (kitab ke safha 248 par chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Teen condensed formulae. H3C-CH(CH3)-CH(CH3)-CH3, 2,3-Dimethylbutane. H3C-CH(CH3)-CH(CH3)-CH(CH3)-CH3, darmiyani CH3 oopar, 2,3,4-Trimethylpentane. H3C-C(CH3)2-C(CH3)2-CH3, har darmiyani carbon par oopar neeche methyl, 2,2,3,3-Tetramethylbutane.
blocks.caption: Usool 6 ki misalein: 2,3-dimethylbutane, 2,3,4-trimethylpentane aur 2,2,3,3-tetramethylbutane (kitab ke safha 248 par chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Zanjeer H3C-CH2-CH-CH-CH-CH-CH3, baen se daen 7 se 1. Carbons 5, 3 aur 2 se CH3, aur carbon 4 se propyl zanjeer CH2-CH2-CH3. Naam: 2,3,5-Trimethyl-4-propylheptane.
blocks.caption: Usool 7 ki misal: 2,3,5-trimethyl-4-propylheptane (kitab ke safha 249 par chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Zanjeer CH3-CH-CH2-CH-CH-CH3, baen se daen 6 se 1, carbons 5, 3 aur 2 par CH3. Naam: 2,3,5-Trimethylhexane (2,4,5-trimethylhexane nahi).
blocks.caption: Usool 8 ki misal: 2,3,5-trimethylhexane (kitab ke safha 249 par chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har khaake mein neela shaded hissa parent (sab se lambi) zanjeer hai aur gulabi daira substituent. Numbers us sire se shuru hote hain jo substituent ke qareeb hai. Kitab ki chhapai mein kuch galtiyan thin jo yahan theek kar ke dikhayi gayi hain: usool 5 mein carbon 5 'CH' chhapa hai, sahi CH2 hai; usool 6 mein doosre compound ka naam '2,3,4-trimethyl butane' chhapa hai magar zanjeer paanch carbon ki hai, sahi naam 2,3,4-trimethylpentane hai; 2,2,3,3-tetramethylbutane ke aakhir mein ek faltu 'CH' chhapa hai; usool 7 mein carbons 5 aur 4 'CH2' chhape hain aur propyl CH3-CH2-CH3 likha hai, sahi CH (carbon 5 par CH3) aur CH2-CH2-CH3 hai; usool 8 mein carbon 6 'CH2' aur carbon 5 'CH2' (neeche CH2) chhape hain, sahi CH3 aur CH (neeche CH3) hain.

blocks.prompt: 2,3,3-trimethylhexane ka displayed formula likhein aur CH3C(CH3)2CH2CH(CH3)CH3 ka naam rakhein (Quick Check 11.1b; usool 6 aur 8).
blocks.explanation: 2,3,3-Trimethylhexane: chhe carbon ki zanjeer carbon 2 par ek methyl aur carbon 3 par do ke saath, CH3CH(CH3)C(CH3)2CH2CH2CH3. Doosre compound mein paanch carbon ki zanjeer hai jis par ek sire se carbons 2, 2 aur 4 par ya doosre se 2, 4 aur 4 par methyls hain; pehle farq ke nuqte par chhota number jeet-ta hai: 2,2,4-trimethylpentane.

items: Sab se lambi zanjeer = parent; substituent ke qareeb sire se number; substituents numbers ke saath pehle, huroof-e-tahajji mein (di, tri nazar-andaz); ek hi carbon: number do baar; ek jaise groups: di, tri; barabar zanjeerein: zyada substituents; barabar shakh faasla: pehle farq par chhota number.
